observations: Two photos show a black PlayStation console with a glossy/texture finish and a vertical stand position.
The console front face is visible; there is no clear readable model text on the console in these photos.
No controller is shown in either photo.
No ports, power cable, HDMI cable, or disc drive area is shown.
A watermark text overlays the images; it does not show the PS4 Pro model clearly.
The seller’s store branding appears on the bag/box (McSteve), but it does not confirm the console model.

claims.claim: Uk Used Sony PS4 Pro Console with one controller Pad
claims.evidence: Photos show a PS4-family console shape, but the PS4 Pro model cannot be read clearly, and no controller is shown.

risks.risk: Console model may not be PS4 Pro (could be PS4 Slim/other variant).
risks.proof: A clear photo of the console label/sticker showing the exact model number (e.g., CUH-7xxx for Pro) and a photo of the back ports.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a generic used PS4 console (worst-case: not Pro).

risks.risk: No proof it includes a controller; may be console only.
risks.proof: Photo of the controller(s) included, showing the DualShock face and back label.

risks.risk: Functionality not confirmed (may have faults: HDMI, disc drive, overheating, no power).
risks.proof: Video clip of power-on and boot to the PS4 home screen, plus a quick test of disc drive (if applicable).
risks.if_unproven: Price as not guaranteed working (worst-case: needs repair).

risks.risk: Storage size and condition (HDD/SSD capacity, health) not shown.
risks.proof: Photo of Settings > Storage (or system info) showing total storage and free space.
risks.if_unproven: Price as lowest common storage/unknown condition.

risks.risk: Account/console lock status not shown (may be linked to an account).
risks.proof: Photo/video showing the console is signed out and can reach settings without account lock issues (or show 'Deactivate as Your Primary PS4' status).
risks.if_unproven: Price with risk of account issues (worst-case: buyer must handle account reset).

proof_requests: Clear close-up photo of the console model label/sticker (model number) and back ports.
Photo of the included controller (front + back label).
Video: power on + boot to PS4 home screen.
Photo/video: Settings > System Information and Storage capacity.
response.reason: The photos do not clearly confirm the PS4 Pro model and do not show the controller or any working/test evidence, so a reliable worst-case price cannot be set from what’s visible.
